name: letsbox
description: Discover entitled Lets Box workflows and run Remote eBay Research and Restock through one authenticated MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Discover entitled workflows from one connection.
interface.longDescription: Lets Box discovers your current contract after login and exposes only entitled workflows. Remote-ready workflows run through MCP; workflows still being migrated are clearly marked as legacy fallback.
defaultPrompt: 利用できるLets Boxスキルを一覧にして。
$letsbox:run-ebay-profit-research Lets PluginのRemote MCP版でeBay利益リサーチを最後まで実行して。ローカル版は使用しないで。
$letsbox:run-ebay-restock Lets PluginのRemote MCP版でeBay在庫戻しを最後まで実行して。readモードと最安値更新は使用しないで。
